request.query: The coefficient l1 norm of the zero integer multivariate polynomial is zero.

content.text:
{
  "items": [
    {
      "formal_name": "Polynomial.integralNormalization_zero",
      "informal_name": "Integral Normalization of Zero Polynomial Equals Zero",
      "kind": "theorem",
      "type": "∀ {R : Type u} [inst : Semiring R], Polynomial.integralNormalization 0 = 0",
      "informal_description": "The integral normalization of the zero polynomial in the polynomial ring $ R[X] $ is the zero polynomial, i.e., $ \\text{integralNormalization}(0) = 0 $.",
      "path": "Mathlib.RingTheory.Polynomial.IntegralNormalization"
    },
    {
      "formal_name": "Polynomial.gaussNorm_zero",
      "informal_name": "Gauss Norm of Zero Polynomial is Zero",
      "kind": "theorem",
      "type": "∀ {R : Type u_1} {F : Type u_2} [inst : Semiring R] [inst_1 : FunLike F R ℝ] (v : F) (c : ℝ),\n  Polynomial.gaussNorm v c 0 = 0",
      "informal_description": "For any valuation $ v $ on a semiring $ R $ and any real number $ c > 0 $, the Gauss norm of the zero polynomial in $ R[X] $ satisfies $ \\|0\\|_{v,c} = 0 $. This follows directly from the definition of the Gauss norm, which assigns value 0 to polynomials with empty support (i.e., the zero polynomial).",
      "path": "Mathlib.RingTheory.Polynomial.GaussNorm"
    },
    {
      "formal_name": "Polynomial.toFn_zero",
      "informal_name": "Zero Polynomial Maps to Zero Function under Coefficient Extraction",
      "kind": "theorem",
      "type": "∀ {R : Type u_1} [inst : Semiring R] (n : ℕ), (Polynomial.toFn n) 0 = 0",
      "informal_description": "For any natural number $n$ and semiring $R$, the coefficient extraction map $\\text{toFn}_n$ sends the zero polynomial in $R[X]$ to the zero function in the space of functions from $\\{0, 1, \\ldots, n-1\\}$ to $R$. In other words, $\\text{toFn}_n(0) = 0$, where the left-hand side is the zero polynomial and the right-hand side is the function constant zero on all indices $0 \\leq i < n$.",

    },
    {
      "formal_name": "MvPolynomial.coeff_zero",
      "informal_name": "Coefficient of any monomial in the zero polynomial is zero",
      "kind": "theorem",
      "type": "∀ {R : Type u} {σ : Type u_1} [inst : CommSemiring R] (m : σ →₀ ℕ), MvPolynomial.coeff m 0 = 0",
      "informal_description": "For every monomial $ m $ in the multivariate polynomial ring $ R[\\sigma] $, the coefficient of $ m $ in the zero polynomial is zero, i.e., $ \\text{coeff}(m, 0) = 0 $.",
      "path": "Mathlib.Algebra.MvPolynomial.Basic"
    },
    {
      "formal_name": "MvPolynomial.C_0",
      "informal_name": "Zero Constant Polynomial Identity: $ C(0) = 0 $",
      "kind": "theorem",
      "type": "∀ {R : Type u} {σ : Type u_1} [inst : CommSemiring R], MvPolynomial.C 0 = 0",
      "informal_description": "The constant polynomial embedding maps the zero element of the commutative semiring $ R $ to the zero polynomial in the multivariate polynomial ring $ R[\\sigma] $.",
      "path": "Mathlib.Algebra.MvPolynomial.Basic"
    },
    {
      "formal_name": "Polynomial.ofFn_zero",
      "informal_name": "ofFn of Zero Function Equals Zero Polynomial",
      "kind": "theorem",
      "type": "∀ {R : Type u_1} [inst : Semiring R] [inst_1 : DecidableEq R] (n : ℕ), (Polynomial.ofFn n) 0 = 0",

      "path": "Mathlib.Algebra.Polynomial.OfFn"
    },
    {
      "formal_name": "MvPolynomial.coeffs_zero",
      "informal_name": "Coefficients of the Zero Polynomial Are Empty",

      "type": "∀ {F : Type u_1} [inst : Field F] (d : ℕ), Polynomial.hilbertPoly 0 d = 0",

items.informal_name: Integral Normalization of Zero Polynomial Equals Zero
items.informal_description: The integral normalization of the zero polynomial in the polynomial ring $ R[X] $ is the zero polynomial, i.e., $ \text{integralNormalization}(0) = 0 $.

items.informal_name: Gauss Norm of Zero Polynomial is Zero
items.type:
∀ {R : Type u_1} {F : Type u_2} [inst : Semiring R] [inst_1 : FunLike F R ℝ] (v : F) (c : ℝ),
  Polynomial.gaussNorm v c 0 = 0
items.informal_description: For any valuation $ v $ on a semiring $ R $ and any real number $ c > 0 $, the Gauss norm of the zero polynomial in $ R[X] $ satisfies $ \|0\|_{v,c} = 0 $. This follows directly from the definition of the Gauss norm, which assigns value 0 to polynomials with empty support (i.e., the zero polynomial).

items.informal_name: Zero Polynomial Maps to Zero Function under Coefficient Extraction
items.type: ∀ {R : Type u_1} [inst : Semiring R] (n : ℕ), (Polynomial.toFn n) 0 = 0
items.informal_description: For any natural number $n$ and semiring $R$, the coefficient extraction map $\text{toFn}_n$ sends the zero polynomial in $R[X]$ to the zero function in the space of functions from $\{0, 1, \ldots, n-1\}$ to $R$. In other words, $\text{toFn}_n(0) = 0$, where the left-hand side is the zero polynomial and the right-hand side is the function constant zero on all indices $0 \leq i < n$.

items.informal_name: Coefficient of any monomial in the zero polynomial is zero
items.type: ∀ {R : Type u} {σ : Type u_1} [inst : CommSemiring R] (m : σ →₀ ℕ), MvPolynomial.coeff m 0 = 0
items.informal_description: For every monomial $ m $ in the multivariate polynomial ring $ R[\sigma] $, the coefficient of $ m $ in the zero polynomial is zero, i.e., $ \text{coeff}(m, 0) = 0 $.

items.type: ∀ {R : Type u} {σ : Type u_1} [inst : CommSemiring R], MvPolynomial.C 0 = 0
items.informal_description: The constant polynomial embedding maps the zero element of the commutative semiring $ R $ to the zero polynomial in the multivariate polynomial ring $ R[\sigma] $.

items.informal_name: ofFn of Zero Function Equals Zero Polynomial
items.type: ∀ {R : Type u_1} [inst : Semiring R] [inst_1 : DecidableEq R] (n : ℕ), (Polynomial.ofFn n) 0 = 0
items.informal_description: For any natural number $ n $, applying the linear map `ofFn` to the zero function $ \text{Fin } n \to R $ results in the zero polynomial in $ R[X] $.

items.informal_description: The set of coefficients of the zero polynomial in the multivariate polynomial ring $ R[\sigma] $ is empty, as the zero polynomial has no non-zero monomials.
